name: Short-Cut Potato Latkes with Applesauce & Sour Cream

instructions.primary_message: Place hash browns in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Using your hands, press out excess water. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (850 g) bag hash brown potatoes, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince or grate onion. Add to the bowl with the hash browns along with eggs, flour, milk, and salt; stir well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
59 ml whole milk
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Pour oil into a large skillet and heat over medium-high. (The skillet should have about a ¼-inch of oil.)

Once the oil is hot (a shred of potato should sizzle when dropped in), working in batches, add the potato mixture; using a ⅓-cup measure, scoop the potato mixture into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart, then press down with the back of the measuring cup to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until latkes are golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Arrange latkes on a platter; serve warm or at room temperature with apple sauce and sour cream on the side. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup applesauce
¾ cup sour cream
